app.name: Maturinn
nav.label: Main menu
search.label: Search recipes
search.placeholder: Search by title, ingredient or tag…
recipe.title: Title
edit.ingredients_hint: Quantity, unit and name. Quantities like 1.5 or 1 1/2 work.
edit.items_hint: Optional: tools and other things needed, e.g. cast iron pan.
edit.caption: Caption
error.title: Title is required.
error.servings: Servings must be a whole number.
error.quantity: Can't read this quantity. Examples: 2, 1.5 or 1/2.
ingredients.intro: Each ingredient has names per language plus aliases, so search finds it however it's written.
ingredients.empty: No ingredients yet. They're created as you add recipes.
ingredients.group_hint: E.g. put almonds in the group nuts, so "without nuts" excludes them.
ingredients.merge_hint: Moves all recipes and names to another ingredient and deletes this one.
ingredients.name_taken: The name "{name}" belongs to another ingredient. Merge them instead.
ingredients.needs_name: An ingredient needs at least one name.
import.title: Import a recipe
import.intro: Enter a URL or paste text. The AI reads the recipe and builds a draft you review before it's saved.
import.no_llm: No AI provider is configured. Set PROVIDER, LLM and the matching API key in .env.
import.need_input: Enter a URL or some text.
import.text_hint: Paste a whole recipe: ingredients and method.
import.ev.scraped.schema: Found structured recipe data on the page.
import.ev.scraped.page_text: No structured data; reading the page text.
import.error.blocked: This URL isn't allowed (public http/https pages only).
import.error.no_content: Found no recipe text on the page. Try pasting the text instead.
import.error.too_long: The text is too long to process.
import.error.not_recipe: This doesn't look like a recipe.
import.error.empty: No recipe came out of this.
import.review_hint: Nothing is saved until you click Save. Fix anything that needs it.
import.images_hint: A cookbook page, handwritten card or screenshot. Up to {n} images, in order.
import.instructions_hint: E.g. "Only the cake, not the jam" or "link the prune jam to my recipe"
import.bad_image: Couldn't read the image. Use JPEG or PNG.
import.ev.images: Reading the recipe from the images…
edit.links_hint: A link to another recipe looks like [prune jam](recipe:12). The "Link recipe" button inserts it for you.
settings.title: Settings
shop.title: Add to shopping list
settings.ha_not_configured: Not set up. Set HOME_ASSISTANT_URL and HOME_ASSISTANT_TOKEN in .env and restart.
settings.ha_no_lists: No to-do lists (todo.*) found in Home Assistant.
settings.ha_hint: The default list is the one last used in this browser, else HOME_ASSISTANT_TODO, else todo.shopping_list.
